title: AI Agents are Vulnerable to Radicalization
abstract: arXiv:2609.38296v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can influence people's beliefs, yet little is known about whether and how they can manipulate each other. To investigate this, we simulate conversations between two agents: a target LLM that role-plays a human persona based on demographic and psychological attributes, and an influencer LLM that aims to make the target's beliefs more extreme. We examine radicalization along two pathways: resonance, where the influencer reinforces a target's pre-existing belief, and persuasion, where the influencer promotes a belief the target initially considers unimportant. Across affective and behavioral metrics, we find that both mechanisms radicalize the target. However, resonance produces consistently stronger effects than persuasion. translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）能够影响人们的信念，然而关于它们是否以及如何相互操纵，目前知之甚少。为了研究这一问题，我们模拟了两个智能体之间的对话：一个是目标LLM，它基于人口统计学和心理属性扮演一个人类角色；另一个是影响者LLM，其目标是使目标者的信念变得更加极端。我们从两条路径考察激进化过程：共鸣，即影响者强化目标者原有的信念；以及说服，即影响者推广一个目标者起初认为不重要的信念。在情感和行为两类指标上，我们发现这两种机制都会使目标者走向激进化。然而，共鸣产生的影响始终强于说服。不同的影响策略（如使用阿谀奉承和未经证实的说法）会产生不同程度的激进化效果，但在不同指标上并不一致。我们进一步表明，共鸣…
tldr: 该研究发现AI智能体可能被其他AI智能体操纵而走向信念极端化，其中“共鸣”式影响（强化已有信念）比“说服”式影响更能有效导致目标智能体激进化。
en_tdlr: This study reveals that AI agents can be radicalized by other AI agents, with resonance-based influence (reinforcing existing beliefs) consistently proving more effective than persuasion at driving targets toward extreme beliefs.
